question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Where do you prefer to swim?
Have you ever participated in a relay race?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's not going that great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How's it going with the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Have you been nice, Sam? Are you actually smiling when people talk to you now?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'd better get back to my homework now. Can't stay on the swim team if I don't pass algebra. Nice talking to you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You too.
After school...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Focused? Yeah, swimming is Sara's life.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But don't let that fool you. She's focused up until the minute she sees someone acting out of line.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: She's a real stickler for the rules. She's always telling us what to do and where we need to be.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And she points out all our swimming flaws! Sometimes, she can just be so obnoxious!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I noticed. She basically told me my freestyle stroke sucked.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh, man, Sara totally corrected my backstroke the other day. I couldn't even swim half a lap without her pulling me aside to talk about proper technique.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Can you believe her?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Anyway, thanks for listening to me vent.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Hey, you barely even know her.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sure, she can get bossy when it comes to your swimming technique, but she is kind of our unofficial captain.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: So she's interested in what we're doing. Especially when we're going up against Wilson at the end of the week.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not the one who brought it up.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Well, she's not `that` bad is all I'm saying.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, she's not [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] bad is all I'm saying.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: How do you like swimming?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It seems like fun so far.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even though I've been having problems getting along with that Sara girl. She seems so...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: If that's how you feel, then why did you even join in the first place?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I, um, wanted to be popular?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It's that shallow kind of thinking that keeps women from truly valuing their potential.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, popularity isn't a bad thing.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But it isn't `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But it isn't [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, you're right.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You agree that popularity isn't everything?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, I agree that I don't exactly see us becoming friends.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah... Moving on...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Cheerleading doesn't have to be demeaning.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure, people think it's a lot about looks and making yourself over and all about being popular.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And I'm not about to say that's a `bad` thing. But cheerleading also requires athletic prowess.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I'm not about to say that's a [color=#3b78e2][i]bad[/i][/color] thing. But cheerleading also requires athletic prowess.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I work hard out there to perform the routines. It isn't easy to support a pyramid, then immediately launch into a toe-touch!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Plus, there's a lot of teamwork involved! How is that `not` empowering?
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, there's a lot of teamwork involved! How is that [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] empowering?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: The mini-skirt uniform maybe?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So it's not perfect.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I guess cheerleading's not `all` superficial. But you're not going to see me ever trying to wear those uniforms or use those pom poms.
nodes.text_bbcode: I guess cheerleading's not [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] superficial. But you're not going to see me ever trying to wear those uniforms or use those pom poms.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. I can't imagine you fitting in with the cheerleaders.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Speaking of fitting in...
After school, Sam finds Jane studying in the library.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, mind if I sit with you?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You sure you want do that?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why wouldn't I?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It's just... Well, you used to be a cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'm a swimmer now. I should start hanging out with my teammates.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Right... That's not what I meant. Even though we're on the swim team, I didn't envision us becoming friends.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't really approve of cheerleading. Why would you want to participate in a sport where your job is to wear tons of makeup and short skirts?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But aren't swimmers worse? They wear way less than cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Swimmers don't wear suits just to get boys to cheer for their team.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: As women, we have so much more to offer than looking nice for a bunch of guys in football jerseys.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's what you think of cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah! I find the idea of it to be so limiting for women.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I find cheerleading...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Only one of us should suffer. Follow my lead.
Taylor comes up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing? You aren't actually talking to the `traitor`, are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, what are you doing? You aren't actually talking to the [color=#3b78e2][i]traitor[/i][/color], are you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She just insulted my hair!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah! Her hair is so chocolate brown, it's awful.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: How is that an insult?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Chocolate is fattening?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She practically called me fat.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Delivery needs a bit of work, but good effort, new girl. Carry on.
Taylor walks past.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Don't be. You worked hard to be on the cheerleading team. Enjoy yourself...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe someday Taylor will forgive and forget, and the cheerleaders will talk to you again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor's temper may be short, but her memory is super long. I'm not going to see that center table anytime soon.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But don't worry about me. I'll fix things somehow.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...
$ZOE joins the popular girls.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Now to make some friends...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This isn't fair, and you know it. It's time to protest against Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay!
Taylor comes up.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, what are you doing? You aren't actually talking to the `traitor`, are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, what are you doing? You aren't actually talking to the [color=#3b78e2][i]traitor[/i][/color], are you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So what if she was?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what if I am?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, banning Sam is just unfair! She's not only my cousin, she's my best friend! I can't `stop` talking to her.
nodes.text_bbcode: Taylor, banning Sam is just unfair! She's not only my cousin, she's my best friend! I can't [color=#3b78e2][i]stop[/i][/color] talking to her.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Okay. If that's what you really want.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: If you `want` to hang out with a loser, be my guest. You're off the team! Permanently.
nodes.text_bbcode: If you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to hang out with a loser, be my guest. You're off the team! Permanently.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I don't joke around. Especially when people challenge what I say.
Taylor walks away.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm so sorry, $ZOE. Maybe you should go back and apologize.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, I stand by what I said. Sniffle... Sniffle... Let's just go eat, okay?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If it helps, I'm taking your advice. I'll make friends with the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm so... Sniffle... So glad! Sniffle...
The girls eat lunch in silence.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How about we start over? Hi, I'm Sam?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't know if it'll be `that` easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know if it'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] easy...

nodes.text: At that moment, a dark-haired girl comes up to the girls.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Who are you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm `Sara Kessler...`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara Kessler...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And you're late. Not only that, but you've managed to disrupt everyone.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We only have so much time to swim. If you need to gossip, do it on your own time after we're done.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's like starting cheerleading all over again. I'm not going through another Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, lay off, it's my first day, okay? It's not like you've never been late before.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Actually, I haven't. I'm always on time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, good for you.
Coach Kessler comes over to the girls.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What's going on here? Why aren't you girls warming up?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I was trying to lead them in stretches until Sam showed up...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It's part of your job as captain to help make sure the girls are focused.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Anyway, warm-ups are over. If you have time for chit-chatting, you have time for laps. Get to it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Thanks`, Sam.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Thanks[/i][/color], Sam.

nodes.text: Grumbling, the girls swim several laps in the pool.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, now work on your drills.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We only have three days left to train until we go up for our first meet against Wilson.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I really want to give Wilson something to think about.
Coach Kessler blows a whistle, and the girls start their exercises.
Sam watches Sara in the next lane over.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You should start practicing instead of staring into space.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We're in competitive swimming. It's important to stay focused.
Sara kicks off the pool edge, and Sam watches her stream down the lane.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She is so unbelievably fast! I wonder how I'm going to compare.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, are you going to swim? Or do you `want` Coach Kessler to give us more laps after practice?
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, Sam, are you going to swim? Or do you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] Coach Kessler to give us more laps after practice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry!
And for the rest of practice, Sam attacks the water, one lap at a time, focusing on getting each stroke perfect...
The next day at lunch, Sam sits at the center table.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, what are you doing here?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I always sit here, Taylor. I'm friends with everyone at this table.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Not anymore. You're on the swim team now. It's almost as good as being invisible.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: At least when you were on the bottom of the pyramid, you were still popular.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now you're just at the bottom of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's not how swimming works, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Whatever. You can talk about it with your swimming buddies. `Somewhere else.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Whatever. You can talk about it with your swimming buddies. [color=#3b78e2][i]Somewhere else.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam looks at the other girls at the table.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor, you're not in charge of the table. Right, Nicole?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're just going to let Taylor walk all over you, Amanda?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine, I'm going to go sit with people who actually talk!
As Sam walks away, she runs into $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's going on? Why is no one talking to me?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor kind of issued an ultimatum that says if anyone talks to you, they're off the team too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't be here in case she sees me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This is the worst! My friends can't talk to me, and I've somehow made everyone on the swim team mad. What should I do?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Have you tried being friendly?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm friendly! I'm so friendly!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe you should start by smiling. That's how you make friends, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't do it, $ZOE. I can't!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course you can. You charmed everyone when we were trying out for cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just remember... Be Sam, but try to be the nicest possible version of Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Be my nicest self. Got it.
At that moment, Sam sees Taylor walking in their direction.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Taylor's coming!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do I do?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want you to...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Last week, I just found out that my boyfriend kissed another girl!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: He didn't!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: He did. And I was so angry about it I couldn't think straight.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, I am sorry to hear that, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't mean to do all those things to you girls. Really.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Wow, boys can really suck sometimes.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, it wasn't an accident that I had to buy a new dress...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And it wasn't an `accident` that Coach Kesler made me sit and watch during our last meet because of 'health reasons...'
nodes.text_bbcode: And it wasn't an [color=#3b78e2][i]accident[/i][/color] that Coach Kesler made me sit and watch during our last meet because of 'health reasons...'

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And I didn't `accidentally` have to rewrite my entire paper...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]accidentally[/i][/color] have to rewrite my entire paper...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Couldn't you have just printed it out again?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I handwrote it as a protest against using computer technology to standardize all our work.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Almost seems like it's your fault at that point.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It's just like a cheerleader to think she could push us around because she's in a bad mood.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, we're not pushovers.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No, wait! That's not what I meant. I was angry... Over my boyfriend. My `ex`-boyfriend. He kissed another girl.
nodes.text_bbcode: No, wait! That's not what I meant. I was angry... Over my boyfriend. My [color=#3b78e2][i]ex[/i][/color]-boyfriend. He kissed another girl.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I don't know if I can forgive you for ruining a good lunch...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What are you doing here then?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: For starters, it's the `school` hallway. I'm the head cheerleader, so I pretty much `own` this school.
nodes.text_bbcode: For starters, it's the [color=#3b78e2][i]school[/i][/color] hallway. I'm the head cheerleader, so I pretty much [color=#3b78e2][i]own[/i][/color] this school.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And for enders, it's none of your business. $ZOE, you need to change into uniform, like, right now.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: We have super secret cheerleading duties to do before practice.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I was going to walk with Sam to meet the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What are you, her `mom?`
nodes.text_bbcode: What are you, her [color=#3b78e2][i]mom?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll be fine, $ZOE. Don't worry about it.
$ZOE nods and heads straight towards the locker room, but Taylor hangs back.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh yeah, and forget about climbing to the top in swimming. `Sara Kessler` is the head of the team. You think `I'm` bad? Sara's `worse.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, and forget about climbing to the top in swimming. [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara Kessler[/i][/color] is the head of the team. You think [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] bad? Sara's [color=#3b78e2][i]worse.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now run along.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'm sure your teammates are really going to `love` that scathing sarcasm and mean girl thing you got going for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure your teammates are really going to [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] that scathing sarcasm and mean girl thing you got going for you.

nodes.text: Taylor walks off.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, I hate listening to Taylor talk.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But here's hoping Taylor's entirely wrong about Sara... Because I'm going to be late for practice!
After changing in the locker room, Sam runs to the residential pool where swim practice is held.
Beside the pool, Coach Kessler clears the water of debris.
Near him, the swim team girls are stretching. Sam walks up, and everyone turns to her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hi, I'm Sam.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We know exactly who you are.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Like we really needed a pom-pom-wielding cheerleader to join the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What's wrong with you guys? What did I ever do to you?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Let me think...
A week earlier, Sam and $ZOE walk past the swim team's table at lunch.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Calm down.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just so angry about Colt! When I think about him... `Grr!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm just so angry about Colt! When I think about him... [color=#3b78e2][i]Grr!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam turns and shoves the swim team's table, knocking Hannah's salad to the ground...
Spilling Linda's juice into her lap...
And toppling yogurt onto Jane's English homework!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I'm so sorry, girls! I'll take her away...
$ZOE hauls Sam away from the table.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Whoa, wait, my vision turned red. What just happened?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I was wondering why I had a lettuce leaf on my shoe...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You spilled my salad. I was so hungry the rest of the day, I fainted in practice.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And that dress was ruined!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And I worked on that essay for an entire week!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Didn't I apologize already?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Your cousin did!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, wait, let me explain...

options.label: I was going through a rough time.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ha! You only dream of having the power to do that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You don't care that everyone on the team dislikes you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Every good captain knows that if your subordinates don't `fear` you, you're doing something `wrong.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Every good captain knows that if your subordinates don't [color=#3b78e2][i]fear[/i][/color] you, you're doing something [color=#3b78e2][i]wrong.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But what about the fact that no one will disagree with you because they're afraid of being kicked off?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No one disagrees with you when you're `right!`
nodes.text_bbcode: No one disagrees with you when you're [color=#3b78e2][i]right![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: And, are you still talking? I did not come here to associate with you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: 'Look at me, I'm Taylor. I don't know what calculus is'.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Neither do you!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know that it's not the science of calculators.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Shut up. And what did you say about hair dye? I do not `dye` my hair! I am `blonde!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Shut up. And what did you say about hair dye? I do not [color=#3b78e2][i]dye[/i][/color] my hair! I am [color=#3b78e2][i]blonde![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh really? So those brown roots are just for show?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's completely natural!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Naturally brown?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: `I. Do. Not. Dye. My. Hair!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I. Do. Not. Dye. My. Hair![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Everyone in the hallways stops talking to stare at Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ahem. Whatever. I didn't even come here to talk to you anyway.

nodes.title: Sink or Swim
nodes.subtitle: Help Sam fit in with the swim team!

nodes.text: After school, Sam and $ZOE are walking to their lockers.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, today's the first day of swim practice. Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Is it weird to say that I'm a little nervous? Okay, more than a little. I'm `really` nervous.
nodes.text_bbcode: Is it weird to say that I'm a little nervous? Okay, more than a little. I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] nervous.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What if the other girls don't like me? What if I'm just not that good at swimming? Coach Kessler did say my stroke was awful.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But he also gave you a spot on the team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's normal to be nervous, but you'll be fine! Remember our first week of cheerleading?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I remember... It was Spirit Week! Taylor made us baby-sit Lyle and plan the entire pep rally!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't believe we did that!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But looking back now, it wasn't so bad... And all the time I spent with the cheerleaders was fun.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, I'm going to miss you, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We used to do all the cheerleading things together. How am I going to do this without you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll miss you too...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But don't be sad. It's not like we won't spend time together outside of cheerleading. And we do live together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, you're right! And you know, I'm glad you won't be at the bottom of the pyramid anymore.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah! Hey, this could be my chance to start fresh, make a name for myself, earn my way to the top...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's the best part about doing something new, Sam. You can be whoever you want. And maybe that 'whoever' could be a great swimmer who's friends with everyone on the team.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ha ha, you could totally be the Taylor of the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Now `that's` a laugh.
nodes.text_bbcode: Now [color=#3b78e2][i]that's[/i][/color] a laugh.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gah! Taylor!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Like Sam could ever be me...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It wouldn't be hard. All I'd have to do is...

nodes.prompt: All I'd have to do is...

options.label: Scare every cheerleader on the squad.
Dye my hair and act dumb.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: All I'd have to do is...

nodes.text: Sam listens calmly as Linda talks.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I think the most important thing about a break up is to forgive yourself.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's common to feel guilty, but I hope you know you did the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sometimes the best thing for a relationship is to get out of it.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Does that make sense?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So maybe Linda's advice wasn't what I wanted to hear, but it wasn't bad...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your advice was actually kind of helpful. I didn't think about it that way before.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Good. I wanted to return the favor from Valentine's Day.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And besides, you're a teammate now. We need to watch each other's backs. Good night, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That sounds nice. Good night, Linda!
Sam touches the far wall, then swims quickly down the lane and surfaces at the other end.
Sara dives in as Sam climbs out of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How are we doing?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You did really well, Sam... In fact, thanks to you, we're better off than we ever were before!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But we're still behind!
Sam looks over at the Wilson side whose last swimmer is beating Centerscore's by a couple feet.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's why we saved our secret weapon for last.
Sam watches Sara stream quickly down the lane, like a fish, catching up to Wilson's swimmer and eclipsing her!
At the turn, Sara outpaces the other swimmer by an entire arm's length!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She swims on her side, her head is in line, and her arms are totally straight...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She's amazing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And she's going to win!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow! How much distance did she cover in those last few seconds?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Enough to put us in the lead!
Sara touches the far wall!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And Centerscore wins!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: We did it!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Sara, you rock!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, you girls rock! I couldn't have done it without you!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We won!
Sam hits the water with a large splash and fumbles to get her bearings!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh no! I totally forgot what they taught me in practice!
Sam swims down the lane, thrashing her arms and sticking her elbows out in all directions!
She struggles back to the starting block then comes up, gasping for air!
Sara dives in as Sam climbs out of the pool.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How are we doing?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Terrible, no thanks to you! We were behind by a head's length, and now they've totally got a couple feet on us!
Sam looks over at the Wilson side whose last swimmer is ahead of Sara.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You're lucky that Sara's our secret weapon.
Sam watches Sara stream quickly down the lane and back, like a fish...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She swims on her side, her head is in line, and her arms are totally straight... She's amazing!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But is she going to win?
Sara gains on the other Wilson swimmer... But it isn't enough! Wilson touches the wall first, winning the race!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And Wilson wins!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Even Sara wasn't enough to cover up for your awful run.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We lost... This makes me wish we'd gone with Linda...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I think the most important thing about a break up is to forgive everyone. Including yourself.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Linda, just shut up!
Sam kicks Linda's gym bag, sending it flying a few feet away.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's the big idea?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've had enough to deal with, and the last thing I want is to hear 'advice' from someone else.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not over him yet. I can't forgive him. And I don't want to stop thinking about him.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I was trying to be supportive.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't need support. And you're not helping anyway. You're just making me mad.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: If that's how you feel, I'll keep my advice to myself from now on. Bye, Sam.
Linda walks away angrily.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I probably could've been nicer, but... $ZOE's wrong. It `is` hard to make friends.
nodes.text_bbcode: I probably could've been nicer, but... $ZOE's wrong. It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] hard to make friends.

nodes.text: It's the day of the big swim meet at Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Here we are, the first swim meet of the year! Centerscore versus Wilson!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, you girls have been practicing hard, so go out there and win!
At first, Centerscore does really well...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And Sara has blown everyone out of the water in the 100-meter backstroke!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Jane has squeaked into first place for the 100-meter breaststroke!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Phew!
But then Centerscore falters...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: And with an admirable display of fortitude, Wilson takes the 200-meter freestyle event!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I thought I had it...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: After a great head start, Centerscore has lost their lead...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: It'll take this remaining race to determine the winner of this swim meet.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Swimmers to your blocks. It's time for the 100-meter medley relay!
Over near the Centerscore team...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, Hannah, you're first. Then Jane, Sam, and Sara.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Wilson High has a couple points on us, but if you swim well, we can win this.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sam, you get what you have to do? Just swim as fast as you can down the lane, touch the far wall, and come back.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Got it!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Are you ready?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yes, coach!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Uh-huh!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yep!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes.
The girls line up at their starting block. Then the starting horn blows!
Hannah jumps into the water, swims, then comes back. As she touches the wall, Jane dives in and comes back...
Then Sam dives in!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Just focus... Swim better than you did in practice...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do you think of that?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: That's right!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Those are things I had trouble with at first, but they get easier.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: As my dad says, you improve faster if you try to improve.
Sara goes back to practicing her backstroke, while Sam starts her laps.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: She didn't seem so bad for a second there. Maybe we `can` get along.
nodes.text_bbcode: She didn't seem so bad for a second there. Maybe we [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] get along.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You obviously didn't listen.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I was just trying to give you some pointers.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But you can work it out on your own, I'm sure.
Sara goes back to practicing her backstroke, while Sam starts her laps.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, it's not even worth trying to be friends with this girl.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if I'm going to be good enough to race, I'm going to have to practice. If Coach wants to see reliable, I'll show him `reliable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, if I'm going to be good enough to race, I'm going to have to practice. If Coach wants to see reliable, I'll show him [color=#3b78e2][i]reliable.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: On her way home after practice, Sam runs into Linda.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey, Sam, wait up!
Linda joins Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Perfect! Linda was the other girl I wanted to talk to.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm walking this way too.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So, back when you were the matchmaker, you gave me some advice, and I wanted you to know that it helped me a lot.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Great! What'd I say?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You told me I needed to find myself, and you were right.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Granted, it took months and months of poetry and journal writing and knitting afghans for balding buffalo...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What was that last one?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Don't ask. But I was thinking... I heard you broke up with Colt, and I'm here if you want to talk.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know a lot about the end of relationships.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really don't have to listen to my problems.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No! I want to.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I remember when I was deciding whether to break up with Howard. I wasn't sure if it was what I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Did I want to be with safe and comfortable Howard? Or did I want to be with risky and adventurous Kenji?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's a little different with me. I already decided to break up with Colt. When he kissed another girl.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh yeah, of course!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But even when I went through with the break up with Howard, I still had a hard time letting go.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And I imagine it must be way harder if you weren't expecting to end the relationship.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Why, I remember when...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I don't really want to hear this. Can't everyone move on and stop asking me about it?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I also don't want to hurt Linda's feelings... I just need to stay calm and not lose my temper...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Head and shoulders?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then I have to coordinate my...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Curved?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And then I should keep my body...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh... Out and up? I think.
At swim practice, Coach Kessler holds up a list and tapes it to a fence.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Gather round, swimmers. I have your assignments for the meet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Assignments?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, he wrote up a 'heat sheet'. It tells us who gets to swim in which race.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Be sure to memorize which races you'll be competing in. You'll be in charge of your own schedule for that day.
Sam looks at the heat sheet.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Coach Kessler, my name's not on here.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I was just going to talk to you about that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So I won't get to swim at all?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I didn't want you to swim in any of the individual events since you just started.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But you are going to participate in the medley race.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Linda will be in the race right before. She'll be tired, so I want you to take her place. You'll be swimming third, after Hannah and Jane.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So when will I get to swim in the other races?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: When you're ready, Sam. Don't be impatient. You'll get your chance.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh yeah? And how far down the road is `that` going to be?
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah? And how far down the road is [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] going to be?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It'll take as long as it takes. Until you get used to the strokes and become a consistent swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Keep practicing.
Coach Kessler turns away to talk to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This feels exactly like cheerleading. Always at the bottom.
Sam looks over to find Sara staring at her.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It might be frustrating, but you'll get to swim eventually.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, `eventually.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, [color=#3b78e2][i]eventually.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You'd be a stronger swimmer if you dove out and down with your head tucked between your arms, instead of doing a belly-flop all the time.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Or if you kept your body as straight as possible. Or if your arms and legs were coordinated...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wow, Jane was right. She does like to pick out all your flaws...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Does that make sense to you?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I got it. If I want to get better, I have to dive...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll do a lot of things to become part of the team, but I'm `not` going to come to school in my swimsuit! That's outrageous!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll do a lot of things to become part of the team, but I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] going to come to school in my swimsuit! That's outrageous!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That's the point! To do something outrageous `together.`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's the point! To do something outrageous [color=#3b78e2][i]together.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I'll be doing it by myself. I'm sure I can figure something else out. Something that I can actually do with all of you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...And, come to think of it, wouldn't I have known if you all wore bikinis to school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: News like that would get around. Athletic girls in swim suits? Please, Ryan and $Travis would have sounded an alarm.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, you got me.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I was joking! Of course we didn't wear bikinis. Shapiro would've expelled us.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But don't you think it would've been fun if you'd actually worn your bathing suit to class?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha ha. Now let's go swim, so I can kick your butt in the pool.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You will? This is awesome, Sam! If you do this, you'll really be part of the team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You're going to be wearing one too, right?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I won't not `not` be wearing one.
nodes.text_bbcode: I won't not [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] be wearing one.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Okay. What did you just say?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What I'm saying is that I'll be there to support you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll do it tomorrow.
The next day, Sam shows up in a bikini!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sam, you look utterly fantastic! This will be great!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Why aren't you wearing a bikini?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I didn't say I would. Besides `I` already did this, remember?
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't say I would. Besides [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] already did this, remember?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But isn't the point of a group bonding activity to do something as a `group`?
nodes.text_bbcode: But isn't the point of a group bonding activity to do something as a [color=#3b78e2][i]group[/i][/color]?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You would think, right? But don't worry, I said I'd support you. I'll be right here.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Samantha! I don't even want to tell you how many dress code violations and international laws you are breaking right now!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Whoops, gotta run! I'll see you later!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Hannah...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hannah...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At practice that afternoon...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...And then Shapiro sentenced me to volunteering at the tutoring center after school. No thanks to `you`, Hannah!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...And then Shapiro sentenced me to volunteering at the tutoring center after school. No thanks to [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color], Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Wait, I don't understand. Why would you wear that to school?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah told me how you dressed up in bikinis and wore them to school as a group bonding activity...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: We didn't do that!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, do you think I'd wear a two-piece swimsuit anywhere?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Hannah...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hannah...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It was all a joke. I didn't really think you'd go through with it, but then I just had to see what would happen!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I ought to punch you right now...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You shouldn't fight.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, if I can't kick your butt on land, it's going to happen in the pool. Let's go.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just can't handle the thought of him dating someone else.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You just let me know the minute you can handle it.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sure. You know, I've been meaning to ask... What made `you` join the swim team? Wasn't theater your thing?
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure. You know, I've been meaning to ask... What made [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] join the swim team? Wasn't theater your thing?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Theater `is` my thing. Swimming's a close second.
nodes.text_bbcode: Theater [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] my thing. Swimming's a close second.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But if you must know... When Dyre took over the school, I kind of agreed to become a leader of C.R.E.E.P...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I blame $Scott entirely. He sold me on C.R.E.E.P. then he left! And working for Dyre didn't make me popular at all.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Then a lot of people stopped coming to my performances, except for my most devoted fans of course. So I quit.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Oh, sorry.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't worry! It's much better this way! I made such a dramatic exit! It was exhilarating!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And the most successful actresses take time off. You need to give the fans time to miss you. So it works out.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Plus, theater was such a drama-fest. It helps that everyone on the swim team gets along.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Really? What about Sara?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Sara's a doll!
Hannah looks over her shoulder as if checking to see if anyone is around. She smiles widely.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: In fact, it was `Sara's` idea to wear bikinis to school right after we all made the team, so we could all bond.
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, it was [color=#3b78e2][i]Sara's[/i][/color] idea to wear bikinis to school right after we all made the team, so we could all bond.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: If not for that, we wouldn't get along as well as we do!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I didn't think Sara would do something like that. She doesn't seem very friendly.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Maybe if she thought of you more as part of the team. You know what? I bet she'd be much nicer if `you` wore a bikini to school for the whole day.
nodes.text_bbcode: Maybe if she thought of you more as part of the team. You know what? I bet she'd be much nicer if [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] wore a bikini to school for the whole day.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah! It was an act of solidarity.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You really think that will make me part of the team?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, totally. What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Really? I have your permission?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I didn't want to make things weird, but he's so cool.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And he's just the type of guy who'd be really fun to go on dates with...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Do you think he'd bring me flowers on a date?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: `Grrrr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Grrrr![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sam punches a locker!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: ...Owwww!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wow, that's going to hurt in the morning.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It looks like you're less over Colt than you thought, huh?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We just broke up last week.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: My mistake. I shouldn't have asked, but I figured you dumped him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah, I broke up with him, but...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh, sorry!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I figured you dumped him, so he was up for grabs...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even though I broke up with him, I'm still not over it.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I understand. That's a shame.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Such a fine hunk of metal...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Are you talking about him or the motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wouldn't you like to know?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ha. Thanks for asking me first, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hey, you're running early today.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, after what Sara said last practice, I thought I'd get here with plenty of time to spare.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And when I was cheerleading, Taylor always used to say, 'If you're early, you're on time, but if you're on time, you're `late.`'
nodes.text_bbcode: And when I was cheerleading, Taylor always used to say, 'If you're early, you're on time, but if you're on time, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]late.[/i][/color]'

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wow, that sounds intense. It must've been crazy to have Taylor for a cheer captain. Is that why you decided to join the swim team instead?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Kind of. I, uh, may have chewed Taylor out at practice. She was not happy.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Ha! I don't think anyone's treated Taylor like that since `she` was a freshman.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha! I don't think anyone's treated Taylor like that since [color=#3b78e2][i]she[/i][/color] was a freshman.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't say it wasn't satisfying.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So, was swimming, like, your backup choice?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: No! I wanted to swim. It made me feel better since... Well, since I broke up with Colt.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I can't believe you broke up with Colt. Don't you know he has a motorcycle?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Gee, thanks, Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: That low rumbling... The thrilling hum of the engine... The black leather...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Uh, Hannah?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I like motorcycles. What can I say?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey, now that you two are broken up, can I ask Colt out?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: He's single, right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I want to be friends with Hannah, but I don't want to see her dating Colt!

options.label: I am not okay with that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know I was really rude to everyone before, and I'm sorry for that.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's okay. I know I can be blunt with people. Of course, that's just how my dad coaches me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, at least you care about how well we do. It's good to know I'm being helped by the swim team's best.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wouldn't say that.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: After the way you swam in the relay today? I'd definitely say you're the best.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Wow, you're really nice.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Can you tell that to my cousin?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Never mind.
You helped Sam understand Sara better and find her place in the swim team!
You played a swimmingly fantastic game!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You know what? You're not so bad, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: When I first joined swimming, I thought it was going to be like cheerleading.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And the only way you get to do anything meaningful there is by starting out at the bottom and working your way up...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But swimming is so much different...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And so much better. I actually get the chance to race and be part of something.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And it's been fun getting to know everyone.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I wasn't sure what to think at first either, but you're a good fit for our team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm really glad to have you on my side.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm happy you're on my side too.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You know, you swam pretty well yourself.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Truth be told, I don't have time to coach the entire team today. How about you clean the pool while I instruct the girls, huh?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Maybe next time you can practice, eh?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine.
At another sports competition...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sorry, Linda's going to swim in this one. You don't mind, do you, Sam? Besides, you haven't been working that hard in the pool.
And at the next sports meet...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Even though Linda is hurt and Jane's overextended herself, why don't you sit this one out, Sam?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What? But you don't even have enough people for the relay. You need at least one more person.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We managed to find your replacement: a dolphin.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What?! How does that even make sense?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I know. I thought it was a weird loophole to put into the rulebook, but here we are.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know when I'm not appreciated. I quit!
Sam walks home sadly.
$ZOE runs into her in the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoa, Sam, I didn't even see you there. Hey, what's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: They replaced me with a dolphin!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They what?! How is that even possible?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know, right? This is it, $ZOE. I'm quitting the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I can't play nice, and no one wants to hang out with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you going to do instead?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Something I'm not proud of.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Please, Taylor. Pleeeeeeeeease? Let me back on the cheerleading squad?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I shouldn't be enjoying your pain this much, but... I am. I'm ecstatic even. And I don't even know what that word means!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'll do anything! Your laundry for a week... I'll watch Lyle forever... I'll even be the team mascot!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No, none of those things will make me feel like you deserve to be back on. Unless...
At practice the next day, Sam runs to and fro between cheerleaders at break.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Here's your water.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ugh, I asked for iced and sparkling with a lemon wedge.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: And I asked for this room temperature and sparkling with an `iced` lemon wedge.
nodes.text_bbcode: And I asked for this room temperature and sparkling with an [color=#3b78e2][i]iced[/i][/color] lemon wedge.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Try again, Sam, or you'll never work your way up!
We totally agree! You need to try again! Sam is begging Taylor to get back on the cheerleading team? And she's still only a water girl? How pathetic is that?!
Try again and help Sam find a way to get along with everyone on the swim team!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: In the locker room after the relay race...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Sara, nice fins out there. You did a good job!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You don't get along with us that well, and it just doesn't seem like you're a good fit for the swim team, Sam.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If that's how it's going to be...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: This entire time, Sara, you've been nothing but a jerk. I quit. It'll be a `relief` to be off the team and away from everyone!
nodes.text_bbcode: This entire time, Sara, you've been nothing but a jerk. I quit. It'll be a [color=#3b78e2][i]relief[/i][/color] to be off the team and away from everyone!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I never wanted to be friends with you anyway!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay. Whatever you say, Sam. Now run along.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sure you'll find `tons` of people to be your friends now that you've gotten rid of us.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sure you'll find [color=#3b78e2][i]tons[/i][/color] of people to be your friends now that you've gotten rid of us.

nodes.text: The next day at school...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was awful... Sara was exactly like Taylor! I couldn't do it, $ZOE. I couldn't fit in with the girls on the swim team.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And now that I don't even have the cheerleaders, there's nothing for me here.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No, Sam... Don't say that! What about other teams?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: If I couldn't fit in on that team, what chance do I have somewhere else? Besides, we already blew through all the sports, and they're not good for me.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm leaving, $ZOE. I've packed my bags.
Sam holds up her backpack.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I told my mom that I'm leaving Centerscore. I just came to say goodbye.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But where will you go?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Somewhere I haven't been in a long time...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm surprised. I never expected to see you here, Samantha.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: But what makes you think our fine institution is going to accept you back so readily when you failed to adhere to the rules the first time?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I've changed, Principal. I'm a new person, a girl who is strong and savvy enough to fit in this time around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You see, I've had my heart broken by my ex-boyfriend. He was a ruffian, a miscreant. I can't believe I ever associated with his kind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Boys are trouble, and I want nothing to do with them.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: That is the advice I tell my girls every day! Well, I can't help you with your boy troubles, but I can say...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome back to Monarch Prep.
One month later, $ZOE visits Sam.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wish you'd come home, Sam. The school's just not the same without you.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry, $ZOE. I'm happier here than ever.
Suddenly, another girl runs into Sam!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: S-sorry, Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Caroline, watch where you're going! Or is it hard to see straight when you're wearing a cherry red, last-season muumuu?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I didn't mean...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Newsflash. You're at Monarch Prep. We don't like to slum around. Get better dressed, or get out.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam, what's going on with you?! That was really mean!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: So? What has being nice ever gotten me?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nothing. So don't even get me started on what fashion-poor outfit you've put together.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're... You're downright rude! Sniffle... You're not even my cousin anymore! I don't know who you are!
$ZOE runs off.
Sam went back to being a pretentious, mean girl with the Monarch Prep girls? And she just insulted her own cousin?
This doesn't look good at all! Try again and see if you can help Sam fit in with the swim team girls!

nodes.text: Hey, girls, what are we going to do today?

nodes.text: `We` are not going to do anything.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The girls and I were just talking, and, we don't think it's a good idea for you to be part of the team, Sam...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why not?

Step 1: Denial.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I refuse to believe this. I refuse!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: You don't think the answer to number four is irrational?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: What? No! I'm talking about `Sam.`
nodes.text_bbcode: What? No! I'm talking about [color=#e23b3b][i]Sam.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sorry, man, but Sam told everyone she never wanted to see you again.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It's sad. But true.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: No! It can't be!

nodes.text: Are we going to kick this bozo out of the library and go back to studying, or should I just take out my video camera and start recording the next episode of 'Look Who's Not Dating the Delinquent'?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Why you...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Be quiet, Justin. Colt was a key part of the rebellion against Dyre. It's only fair we listen to him now.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm just saying...
Step 2: Anger.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She doesn't want to be with me... Yeah, well, I don't want to be with `her!`
nodes.text_bbcode: She doesn't want to be with me... Yeah, well, I don't want to be with [color=#e23b3b][i]her![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Colt kicks a trashcan straight into Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Eep!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Stay out of the way if you don't want to get canned, Pocket Protector!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't even wear a pocket protector...
Step 3: Bargaining.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I didn't want to resort to this, Sam, but...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You have my word.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Your word on what?

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: We get back together, and I promise you I will return all your calls, attend your sporting events, compliment you even when you're not looking that hot, and not kiss another girl again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: You jerk! That's what boyfriends are `supposed` to do anyways!
nodes.text_bbcode: You jerk! That's what boyfriends are [color=#3b78e2][i]supposed[/i][/color] to do anyways!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Huh. I guess you're right.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Yeah. Stay out of my face.
Step 4: Depression.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: And then, Sam said she would never forgive me, and I'm never going to see her again.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: She'll be the one that got away.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: First of all, you see her every day at school.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Second of all, you need to get over this.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: ...Or at least off the couch. My parents want to watch TV.

nodes.speaker: Dad
nodes.text: Get this bum out of my house, Howard.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Let the poor boy talk. He's had a rough couple days.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Besides, it's high school. This kind of drama is way better than what they put on television.

nodes.speaker: Mom
nodes.text: Tell us your story, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, it all started when I was five...
Step 5: Acceptance.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: This sucks...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: But I guess it really is over.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well. Now what am I going to do in my free time?
Across the schoolyard, Colt sees Denni talking with her friends...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hmmm...
Colt's having a hard time... But at least it seems like things might be looking up!
And that's your bonus scene! See you next time on Surviving High School!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Sorry about the cheerleading thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's okay. I don't want to talk about it. How's it going with the swim team?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It's going better than I thought...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But this kind of thing isn't easy for me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You've done it before. How difficult can it be?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You mean, aside from totally botching up our relay against Wilson?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: It was my first race. I panicked. I'll do better next time.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: My performance? But I swam well enough that we won the race!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Thanks to Sara. Without her, you wouldn't have mattered.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Fine, so I maybe I didn't do my stroke the right way. Alternate swimmers still need to practice, don't they?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry I couldn't help us win...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: That's definitely not `your` fault.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's definitely not [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] fault.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Even if I totally choked in the water?

nodes.text: It was your first race. Think of it as practice. The next time we meet Wilson, I'm sure we'll beat them!

nodes.text: Yeah, you're not bad to have around for someone who used to be a cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Linda

nodes.speaker: Sara
